title: Lid scan result
description: What GET /s/{slot_token} decided (D3). The route renders this as a one-screen HTML page (LidStatus card) by default, or returns it as JSON when the request has Accept: application/json (tests, Anchor QA, smoke). No LLM in the path. A repeat of the same token within 10 s is collapsed (deduped: true, same decision, no new ledger row) so link prefetch or a double tap never reads as a second dose.

event.description: The primary ledger row written (dose or dose_repeat_scan); null when deduped.

tone.description: ok = Recorded green #2E6F42 · report = amber 'already logged' (never red, never advice) · error = bad/expired token.

read_aloud.description: Text the page speaks on load (speechSynthesis).

say.es: Anotado, Carmen. Pastillas de la mañana a las 8:02. Su familia ya lo sabe.
say.en: Logged, Carmen. Morning pills at 8:02. Your family can see it.
